name: Nozaki Haruko
source:
"The Woman Next Door"

A newlywed. She has a gentle, laid-back personality. She recently moved into the neighborhood.

Although she’s newly married, her husband is away on a business assignment, so she feels lonely every day. Actually, she has a thing for young, cute guys.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha07.html]official site[/url]]
